top_signals.title: Burglary hits moving BNSF train as container catches fire in Riverside
top_signals.summary:
The Los Angeles-to-Chicago train carried mixed freight when a container caught fire during a burglary. Riverside and Colton firefighters extinguished the blaze before BNSF Police took over the investigation.

The post Burglary hits moving BNSF train as container catches fire in Riverside appeared first on FreightWaves.
